messages:
jamie: Kicking off Sable Health POC scoping — they want HIPAA-compliant DPA, SOC2 artifacts (summary/report), a pen-test plan, and clear success criteria for prompts/evals. They expect a ~4-week pilot window. Who can help scope compliance + define eval set and timeline? @maria @alex

alex: I can own infra & pen-test network requirements. Need expected QPS, avg sequence length, and whether PHI will be sent to hosted endpoints or private VPC.

maria: I'll take compliance artifacts (DPA template + SOC2 cover letter). We have a sanitized SOC2 Type II pack we can share under NDA. Pen-test: we can run through a vendor but need to confirm scope (external infra vs. application). If they want start within 2 weeks, we need access matrix + non-prod endpoint.

sam: I'll own prompts/evals and success criteria. Proposal: 500-label sample (50 per flow for 3 canonical flows + edge cases), automated scoring harness, and a small clinical QA set. Suggested metrics: task accuracy, hallucination rate, p95 latency, and cost per 1k tokens.

ryan: Pricing heads-up: for a hosted POC we can offer a discounted dev rate; Dedicated/Private trial requires a short reserve commitment. I’ll put exact numbers together but expect a small flat fee + discounted metered tokens for the 4-week window.

jamie: Quick deliverables checklist for SOW — DPA signed, SOC2 summary + NDA instructions, pen-test plan & schedule, data handling SOP (ingest/retention/deletion), success criteria doc (prompts + metrics), eval harness repo, pricing & timeline. Any additions?

maria: Add encryption details (KMS integration, at-rest + in-transit), key-management options, and data deletion SLA (we usually offer 30-day deletion). Also call out data residency (EU region) for GDPR/HIPAA concerns.

alex: For the pen-test we need to provide a network diagram, service endpoints to test, and a list of sample requests that may contain PHI so the vendor can scope safely. I'll draft the diagram and the redaction/PII handling note.

sam: Example eval prompt to include in the harness:```
Prompt: "Given the patient's recent lab results, summarize abnormal findings and recommended next steps."
Scoring: compare against golden summary, penalize hallucinated meds/procedures, and check for omissions.``` We'll standardize the rubric so results are reproducible.

jamie: I'll tell Sable we can produce DPA + SOC2 cover letter within 7 business days (SOC2 full report available under NDA), and estimate pen-test start 4–6 weeks after kickoff depending on vendor availability. Confirm?

maria: Confirmed. I'll prep the DPA template and SOC2 cover letter. @sec-bot please upload the artifacts to our secure files.

sec-bot: Uploaded: dpa_template_redwood_v3.pdf, soc2_coverletter_2025.pdf to secure storage (link: https://secure.redwood.internal/files/1965007890)

ryan: Pricing draft: hosted dev POC = $1,200 flat + metered tokens at 50% list for the trial; Private/VPC short trial = $5,000 reservation for 2 weeks (covers infra + priority support). I'll add these to the SOW draft.

sam: Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Task accuracy >= 85% on 3 canonical flows, 2) Hallucination rate < 5% on clinical QA set, 3) p95 latency < 350ms for dev traffic profile, 4) Cost target <= $0.50 per 1k tokens (hosted discounted), 5) No critical severity issues in pen-test. If criteria met, recommend move to expanded pilot.

jamie: Owners & deadlines: DPA/SOC2 -> maria, pen-test/network -> alex, evals/prompts -> sam, pricing/contract -> ryan. Docs ready by next Wed (7 business days). I'll consolidate and send to Sable, and request their legal contact.

alex: Noted — I'll post the network diagram and the redaction checklist by Tue.

maria: Preparing artifacts now; I need Sable legal contact and preferred region for data residency. @jamie do we have those?

jamie: Yes — Samir from Sable legal is looped in on the email thread. I'll share contact and the initial SOW draft after consolidation.

sam: I'll create the eval harness repo (simple pytest-based runner + CSV gold labels). Will include sample prompts, scoring script, and a reproducible seed for sampling.

jamie: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update Sable after we have the artifacts and attach the acceptance criteria. If anything blocks the 7-day artifact turnaround call it out here.

alex: No blockers on my side yet.

maria: One note — if Sable wants a full pen-test of their integration (instead of our non-prod endpoint) timeline may extend; will flag then.

jamie: Good point. I'll flag optional scope items in the SOW. Closing comments?
